Details: Document the decision and rationale according to the National Fact-Finding, Documentation and Retention Policy . Type the appropriate options:
If the parent was paid the wrong type of parental benefits or was initially approved for more parental benefits weeks than entitled to, type [“Parental benefits are payable up to a maximum combined total of 40 standard or 69 extended weeks per birth, adoption or placement for children born or placed for adoption on or after March 17, 2019.” or “Parental benefits are payable up to a maximum combined total of 35 standard or 61 extended weeks for children born or placed for adoption before March 17, 2019.”] The maximum number of weeks that can be paid to one parent is 35 for standard benefits and 61 for extended benefits. When clients share the parental benefits, the parents must share the same type of benefits. The first parent to apply for benefits for this birth, adoption or placement chooses a type of parental benefits. This is the type of benefits the other parent is entitled to. The [ client or other parent ] applied for parental benefits first and is entitled to [ standard or extended ] parental benefits. The other parent is entitled to receive [number of weeks] weeks.”
If the parent has been overpaid as maximum entitlement has been reached, type “Parental benefits are exhausted. A D35 is imposed effective [date]. The parent is not entitled to parental benefits because the maximum of parental entitlement weeks has already been paid for the PW.”
If the parent has had the WP deferred in error, type “Conditions to defer the WP not met as a WP for this birth, adoption or placement has not yet been served.”

step.cmd: Determine if the type of parental benefits must be changed:
Determine the type of parental benefit change being made:

ul.li: If the change is from standard to extended parental benefits, the claim type (CT) is 3 - Sickness major attached or 4 - Maternity or parental and no parental benefits have been paid, go to step 5.
If the change is from standard to extended parental benefits and the CT is 14 - Standard parental , the request has to be completed by IPOC. Go to step 6.
If the change is from extended to standard parental benefits, the request has to be completed by IPOC. Go to step 9.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and complete the following fields:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

Click the Special Benefits (M106) link and enter the following information in the Parental section:
Entitlement weeks: Enter the number of weeks of extended parental benefits the client is requesting.
Click Save.

Waiting period:
If the WP was deferred in error, select X - Rescind .
If the WP was not deferred but should be, select 5 - Waiting period deferred (parental standard or extended) .
Supplementary claim information: Select 99 - Parental extended .

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and complete the following fields:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and impose a 35 - Parental benefits, qualifying conditions not met disentitlement (D35) and the conversion as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

Click the Special Benefits (M106) link and in the Parental section, do the following:
Entitlement weeks: Enter the number of weeks of entitlement (number of weeks the client is entitled to).
Click Save .
Disentitlement: Select 35 - Parental benefits, qualifying conditions not met .
Start date: Select the first week the parent was overpaid parental benefit weeks as the disentitlement start date.

Waiting period: Select the appropriate option:
If the WP was deferred in error, select X - Rescind.
If the WP was not deferred but should be, select 5 - Waiting period deferred (parental standard or extended) .
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select F - Non fraud - Other .
Message: Select 4 - An overpayment resulted due to an indefinite disentitlement .

step.cmd: In ACS, send the N-00-00-00 letter. Unless specified, select the most appropriate option for each of the following attributes:

ul.li: Opening Sentence for Initial / Renewal or Continuing claim (2466) .
If the client is entitled to some weeks, select Special benefits approved (3046) .
If the client is not entitled to any weeks, select Special benefits denied (3065) .

If a D35 is imposed, select Parental benefits denied or suspended - D31, D34, D35, D56, D57, Text Field (3074) .
Select D35 - not qualified or entitled (various reasons) (3077) .
Select D35 - Parental wks already paid to another person .
Indefinite or Definite disentitlement dates (2485): Select Indefinite disentitlement dates and enter the date.
If the parent is not entitled to deferral of the WP because the WP has not yet been served, select Waiting Period Message - (Amount of wks of Waiting Period to serve) or (Deferred WP Denied) (2445) .
Right to Request a Reconsideration (with Blank option) (4169): Select Right to Request a Reconsideration.
If an N-00-00-00 letter was previously sent for this PW, select This letter replaces or footnote (2365) .
